meta.title: About us
meta.description: Pudingku is a small kitchen making puddings and cakes in small batches every day.

about.title: A small kitchen that chose to stay small
about.lead: Pudingku started from something simple: good pudding usually loses because too much of it is made at once. We went the other way.

story.heading: Why small batches
paragraphs: Pudding is honest. Let the milk-to-agar ratio slip even slightly and you taste it immediately — either too firm, or weeping after a night in the fridge. That ratio is easiest to hold when the quantity being cooked stays modest.

So we cap the size of every batch and produce against the orders that come in rather than stacking up stock. The trade-off is plain: we need preparation time, and there are days when a variant simply is not available. We think that is a reasonable exchange.
The recipes are our own and still being adjusted. If a variant is not right yet, we do not sell it.

items.title: Say it as it is
items.body: Ingredients, allergens and how long a product keeps are written out on every product page. When something is not certain yet, we say it is not certain yet.

items.title: Taste first, looks after
items.body: We do not add colouring to make anything look brighter. Our pandan is a soft green and our taro is a pale purple because that is what those ingredients actually look like.

items.title: Fix it when it goes wrong
items.body: A wrong or damaged delivery gets replaced without an argument. The conditions are on the refund policy page.

transparency.heading: What we do not have yet
transparency.body: We choose not to display claims we have no paperwork for. As of the last update to this page, we do not publish a halal certification number or a food distribution permit number on this website. If you need legal documentation for a bulk or corporate order, contact us first so we can explain exactly where things stand.

meta.title: FAQ
meta.description: The questions we get most often about ordering, storage, allergens and delivery.

faq.title: What people ask most
faq.description: If your question is not here, email us — we will add it to this list.

items.q: How far ahead of my event should I order?
items.a: Puddings need at least one day of preparation. Lapis legit, yuzu cheesecake, red velvet and opera need two to three days. For orders above 50 items, contact us first so we can check capacity.

items.q: How long do the products keep?
items.a: Puddings with fresh fruit (mango, strawberry, durian) should be finished within two days. The other puddings keep three days. Lapis legit lasts longest: five days at room temperature or two weeks refrigerated. Each product page states its own guidance.
We do not recommend it. Agar-based puddings break down in texture once thawed and release water.

items.q: Are there egg-free or gluten-free variants?
items.a: Yes. Egg-free and gluten-free variants are marked in the catalog. That said, our kitchen handles egg and gluten in the same space, so we cannot guarantee the absence of cross-contact.

items.q: Can I customise the flavour or sweetness?
items.a: For orders above 30 items we can reduce the sugar. For a flavour outside the catalog we need testing time — please ask first.
Packed with ice packs and sent by instant courier within the city. We do not yet ship between cities because the product has to stay cold.
This website is not connected to any payment system yet. For now, ordering and payment are arranged over email after you send us your order reference number.

items.q: What if my order is wrong or damaged?
items.a: Report it the same day with a photo of the packaging. If the mistake is ours, we replace it or refund it. The details are on the refund policy page.

compliance.title: Policies & disclosure
compliance.description: Everything that applies when you use this website and order from us, written as plainly as we can manage.
compliance.statusBody: This website presents the full catalog and ordering flow, but it is not yet connected to a payment system or an order database. Every order summary and contact message is calculated and validated, then shown back to you — it is not stored and not sent anywhere. This page will be updated as soon as those integrations go live.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.summary: What we ask for, why, and how long we keep it.

p: We only ask for the data genuinely needed to prepare and deliver an order. We do not sell your data to anyone.
When you fill in the order or contact form, we process:
ul: Name, email address and phone number.
Delivery address, city and postal code — only if you choose delivery.
Your preferred date and any note you write yourself.

sections.h: What is stored on your device
p: The contents of your cart are kept in your browser's local storage so they survive a page reload. That data lives on your device, is never sent to our server, and can be cleared at any time from your browser settings.
Your language preference is stored in a single cookie named pk_locale so the site opens in the same language when you return.

In this version of the website, what you type into the forms is not written to a database of ours and is not passed to any third-party service. It is processed transiently on the server to compute totals and validate input, then discarded once the response is returned to your browser.
Once a real ordering system goes live, this section will be updated to describe where data is stored, for how long, and which third parties are involved.

This website loads web fonts from Google Fonts when a page opens, which means your IP address is visible to that provider. We run no analytics, no advertising pixels and no other third-party trackers.

You may request a copy, correction or deletion of the data we hold about you, and may withdraw consent at any time. Send the request to the email address on the contact page and we will respond within a reasonable time.
This website is not aimed at children under 13 and we do not knowingly collect their data.
If this policy changes, the date at the top of the page is updated. Material changes will also be noted on the compliance overview page.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.summary: The basis of the agreement when you order from us.

p: By using this website and submitting an order you agree to the terms on this page. If any part does not work for you, please do not proceed with an order.
An order summary generated by this website does not mean your order has been accepted. An order is accepted only once we reply and confirm the schedule and availability.
We may decline or cancel an order when ingredients are unavailable, production capacity is full, or the details provided are incomplete.
All prices are in Rupiah and include packaging. Delivery is charged separately. Prices may change if ingredient costs change; the price that applies is the one at the moment we confirm your order.
There is no automated payment system on this website. Payment is agreed over email once an order is confirmed. Never send card details or banking credentials through a form on this website.

ul: Provide an address and a contact number reachable on the delivery day.
Tell us about allergies or restrictions before the order goes into production.
Store the product according to the storage guidance immediately on receipt.

p: Our liability for any single order is limited to the value of that order. We are not liable for deterioration that occurs after delivery due to storage that does not follow the stated guidance.
The name, copy, product illustrations and design of this website are ours. Please share the links, but do not reuse the material commercially without written permission.
These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Indonesia.

refund.title: Cancellations & refunds
refund.summary: When an order can be cancelled, and when we replace it.

sections.h: Why the rules are fairly strict
p: Everything is made after an order comes in and cannot be resold. The cancellation window therefore follows when production starts.

ul: More than 24 hours before the pickup or delivery date: the order can be cancelled in full.
Less than 24 hours: production has usually started, so we cannot accept a cancellation.
A date change can be requested once, as long as it is more than 24 hours before the schedule.

p: We replace the product or refund the payment when:
ul: What you received differs from what was ordered.
The product is damaged or has spilled on arrival.
The product is unfit to eat on arrival despite the cold chain being maintained.

p: Report it the same day the order is received, with the reference number and a photo of the packaging and its contents. The sooner it is reported, the easier it is for us to trace where it went wrong.

ul: A difference in taste preference — for example, finding it not sweet enough.
Product that spoiled because it was kept out of the fridge longer than the guidance allows.
A mistyped address that prevented the courier from finding the recipient.

shipping.title: Delivery & pickup
shipping.summary: Service area, how we pack, and preparation times.

p: Puddings need at least 24 hours. Durian needs 48 hours because the fruit is prepared ahead. Lapis legit needs 72 hours. Each product page states its own preparation time.
We currently deliver within the city only, by instant courier, because the product must stay cold the whole way. We do not yet offer intercity or standard-freight shipping.
The exact service area will be listed here once the kitchen address is published. In the meantime, email us to check whether your address is reachable.
Puddings are sealed in cups and placed in an insulated box with ice packs. Cakes go into a rigid box with supports so they cannot shift. Every package is stamped with its production date and time.

The delivery figure shown in the cart is an estimate for in-city delivery and is not a published tariff. The final charge is based on distance and the courier's rate on the delivery day, and is confirmed by email before the order goes into production.
Pickup can be arranged. The address and time window are sent by email once the order is confirmed — we do not publish the kitchen address openly on the website.
Refrigerate puddings straight away. Product left at room temperature for more than two hours falls outside our responsibility.

allergens.title: Allergens & food safety
allergens.summary: The allergens present in our kitchen and how we handle them.

p: Our products may contain one or more of the following:
ul: Dairy — fresh milk, cream, butter, cream cheese, mascarpone.
Egg — in the cakes and in the caramel pudding.
Gluten — wheat flour and biscuit in the cake line.
Tree nuts — almond flour in the opera.
Soy — soy lecithin in some couverture chocolate.
Coconut — coconut milk and coconut shavings.
Sesame — may be used as a garnish on seasonal variants.

p: We work in a single kitchen with equipment used across products. Although equipment is cleaned between batches, we cannot guarantee our products are entirely free of traces of the allergens listed above.
If you have a severe allergy, please do not rely on the catalog markings alone — contact us first so we can explain how that particular variant is made.
The "egg-free" and "gluten-free" markings in the catalog mean the ingredient is not in the recipe. They are not a statement that the product is free of cross-contact.

ul: Fresh ingredients are bought on the day of production.
Every package is stamped with its production date and time.
Chilled products are packed with ice packs and are not left at room temperature before dispatch.
Equipment is cleaned between batches.

p: We do not publish a halal certification number or a processed-food distribution permit number on this website. We choose not to display any number until the document exists and can be shown. If you need such documentation for an event or a corporate order, please contact us first.

cookies.title: Cookies & local storage
cookies.summary: What this website keeps in your browser.

p: This website uses no advertising cookies and no analytics cookies. We store only what is needed for the site to behave the way you expect.

ul: pk_locale — a cookie holding your language choice, so pages open in the same language when you return.
pk.cart.v1 — local storage holding the products and quantities in your cart. Product codes and counts only; no personal data.
pk.consent.v1 — local storage recording that you dismissed the cookie notice.

p: All of it can be cleared from your browser settings, usually under privacy or site data. Clearing it empties your cart and resets the language to the default.
We load web fonts from Google Fonts. That service sets no cookies, but the font request makes your IP address visible to the provider. Beyond that, no other third party is loaded on this website.
